answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the jetty check immediately, the orchard audit keeps the resolved set and the vine replay shows exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 125 aliases as a result forfeits the reading cost 125 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
